# HAF 700 EVO Iris LCD Control v0.0.3

This release adds CPU-fan telemetry and makes the LCD display sequence fully configurable.

## Changes

- Added live CPU fan RPM as display mode 8 and as an eighth dashboard meter with current, session-minimum, and session-maximum values.
- Added eight numbered display-order slots. Each slot can select any available live metric or `Off`, allowing both the included screens and their order to be customized.
- Timed display cycling and the manual **Next** button now follow the same configured sequence.
- Display-order changes apply immediately during a live session and are saved with the other application preferences.
- Preserved the existing single LibreHardwareMonitor helper and two-second snapshot cadence; CPU fan does not create another helper or polling loop.
- Expanded activity and JSONL logging with the selected fan hardware, sensor name, identifier, raw RPM, and transmitted value.
- Fixed **Next** so it advances the selected display sequence even when automatic cycling is disabled.
